elements.description: Shipment records for products moved between factories and shops, including status, dispatch and receipt timestamps, quantities, costs, and notes.
Factories that produce and dispatch shipments, with location, time zone, activity, and operational metadata.
Products tracked in the catalog, including SKU, name, category, description, unit, pricing, and activity metadata.
Machine parameter records keyed by machine, describing factory assignment and configured attribute bounds.
Normalized machine telemetry samples capturing machine state, timestamps, and measured attribute values.
Shop-product availability and merchandising records showing which products are available at each shop and when they are featured.
Real-time sales events from shops, including transaction details, location, channel, payment, weather, temperature, flavor mix, quantities, and totals.
The ice cream shops, with all their geography information and name. These are the shops who actually perform a sale
